outcome: accuracy and grade of FGM classification
postpartum blood loss of more than 500 ml
admission to a special care nursery
cohort: 196 women with FGM who gave birth between 2006 and 2012 at a metropolitan Australian hospital, compared with 8852 women without FGM who gave birth during the same time period
finding: Women with FGM had similar obstetric outcomes to women without FGM, except for statistically significant higher risk of first and second degree perineal tears, and caesarean section.
